finalText:
**Found it.** `engine.js` rounded to two decimal places twice — once after the percent coupon, once after the flat coupon — before converting to the order's currency.

Rounding early in USD, then converting, shifts the cent by a bit whenever the currency's rate isn't 1. That's why USD carts always looked fine while GBP, CAD, and JPY carts landed off whenever a percent coupon was in play.

Fix: only round once, at the very end, in the target currency. All 40 tests pass now (previously 10 failing).
